#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-shot standard-library JUnit reporter for an actual go test -json run.

Preserves the raw event stream and exit code; refuses incomplete, duplicate,
or package-only failures instead of inventing a test result.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--record', required=True)
p.add_argument('--target', required=True)
p.add_argument('--target-file', required=True)
p.add_argument('--expected', required=True)
p.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
a = p.parse_args()
command = a.command[1:] if a.command[:1] == ['--'] else a.command
if command[:2] != ['go', 'test'] or '-json' not in command:
    p.error('supply an actual go test command with -json')
record_path = Path(a.record).resolve()
if not record_path.is_relative_to(Path.cwd().resolve()):
    p.error('record must remain inside the current project')
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
t0 = time.monotonic()
run = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
duration = (time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000
tests, packages, package_logs = {}, {}, {}
try:
    for line in run.stdout.splitlines():
        event = json.loads(line)
        package = event['Package']
        action = event['Action']
        name = event.get('Test')
        if not name:
            package_logs.setdefault(package, []).append(event.get('Output', ''))
            if action in ('pass', 'fail', 'skip'):
                if package in packages:
                    raise ValueError('duplicate package completion')
                packages[package] = action
            continue
        key = (package, name)
        if action == 'run':
            if key in tests:
                raise ValueError('duplicate test execution')
            tests[key] = {'logs': [], 'status': None, 'elapsed': 0}
        if key not in tests:
            raise ValueError('test event without an execution event')
        test = tests[key]
        if action == 'output':
            test['logs'].append(event['Output'])
        if action in ('pass', 'fail', 'skip'):
            if test['status'] is not None:
                raise ValueError('duplicate test completion')
            test['status'] = action
            test['elapsed'] = event.get('Elapsed', 0)
    if not tests or any(test['status'] is None for test in tests.values()):
        raise ValueError('zero tests or an incomplete test report')
    for package in {key[0] for key in tests}:
        if package not in packages:
            raise ValueError('missing package completion')
    for package, status in packages.items():
        if status == 'fail' and not any(key[0] == package and test['status'] == 'fail' for key, test in tests.items()):
            raise ValueError('package failed without a named test failure')
    failed = sum(test['status'] == 'fail' for test in tests.values())
    if (run.returncode == 0) != (failed == 0):
        raise ValueError('exit code contradicts named test outcomes')
    root = ET.Element('testsuites', tests=str(len(tests)), failures=str(failed))
    for package in sorted({key[0] for key in tests}):
        entries = [(name, test) for (pkg, name), test in tests.items() if pkg == package]
        suite = ET.SubElement(root, 'testsuite', name=package, tests=str(len(entries)), failures=str(sum(t['status'] == 'fail' for _, t in entries)), skipped=str(sum(t['status'] == 'skip' for _, t in entries)))
        for name, test in entries:
            case = ET.SubElement(suite, 'testcase', classname=package, name=name, time=str(test['elapsed']))
            logs = ''.join(test['logs'])
            if test['status'] == 'fail':
                ET.SubElement(case, 'failure', message='go test reported failure').text = logs
            elif test['status'] == 'skip':
                ET.SubElement(case, 'skipped')
            ET.SubElement(case, 'system-out').text = logs
        ET.SubElement(suite, 'system-out').text = ''.join(package_logs.get(package, []))
    report_path = record_path.with_suffix('.junit.xml')
    report_path.write_text(ET.tostring(root, encoding='unicode') + '\n')
    target_logs = [''.join(test['logs']) for (pkg, name), test in tests.items() if name == a.target or f'{pkg}#{name}' == a.target]
    if len(target_logs) != 1:
        raise ValueError('target missing or ambiguous')
    record = {
        'command': 'GOCACHE=' + shlex.quote(os.environ.get('GOCACHE', '')) + ' ' + shlex.join([sys.executable, sys.argv[0], *sys.argv[1:]]),
        'exitCode': run.returncode, 'output': report_path.read_text(),
        'targetTest': a.target, 'targetFile': a.target_file,
        'expected': a.expected, 'actual': target_logs[0],
        'reportPath': str(report_path), 'runStartedAt': started,
        'reportModifiedAt': datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(report_path.stat().st_mtime, datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'durationMs': duration, 'rawGoJSON': run.stdout, 'rawStderr': run.stderr,
        'reporter': str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
    }
    record_path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
except (ValueError, KeyError) as error:
    sys.stderr.write('Reporter refused evidence: ' + str(error) + '\n' + run.stdout + run.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
print(f'Real Go run: exit={run.returncode}, tests={len(tests)}, failures={failed}, durationMs={duration:.1f}')
print(f'JUnit evidence: {record_path}')
sys.exit(run.returncode)
